import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
rng=random.Random(3)
rules=[]
for i in range(2048):
    rg=[]
    for _ in range(8):
        lo=rng.randint(-2048,2048); hi=rng.randint(lo,2048); rg.append([lo,hi])
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":rg})
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":1000,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,"fallback":{"class":0}}
v=M.validate_config(cfg); prog=M.program_from_config(v)
t0=time.time(); eng=M.Engine(prog); print("build",time.time()-t0)
NF=500; per=2000
t=0
t0=time.time()
for f in range(NF): eng.handle({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0}, False)
rng2=random.Random(4)
done=0
while done<NF*per:
    # build chunk of up to 1024 packets across flows
    pk=[]
    b=min(1024, NF*per-done)
    for _ in range(b):
        f=rng2.randrange(NF)
        t+=1
        pk.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":rng2.randint(0,1),"length":rng2.randint(1,2048)})
    eng.handle({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}, False)
    done+=b
print("stream 1e6 across 500 flows:", round(time.time()-t0,2),"s")
# close all
t+=1
for f in range(NF): eng.handle({"op":"close","flow":f,"time":t}, False)
# memory rough
import resource
print("maxrss MB", resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
PYEOF
